name: Nepal Open 2018

venue.name: [Kathmandu University](http://ku.edu.np/)
venue.details: Chinese Hall (Day 1), C.v Raman Auditorium (Day 2) follow the directions Indicated by the indicators from the main gate.

information: This competition is the third iteration of **Nepal Open (Nepali National Championship)** and is open to competitors of all nationalities. However, only **Nepalese participants** will be eligible for prizes and titles. यो प्रतियोगिता नेपाल ओपन (नेपाली राष्ट्रिय प्रतिस्पर्धा)को तेस्रो शृङ्खला हो र यो सबै राष्ट्रियताको प्रतियोगीका लागि खुला छ। तर उपाधि तथा पुरस्कार प्राप्त गर्न नेपाली प्रतियोगी मात्रै योग्य हुने छन्। Pre-registration on the WCA website is compulsory. All participants wishing to compete will have to register through this [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018/register). डब्लूसीएको औपचारिक वेबसाइटमा अग्रिम दर्ता गर्न अनिवार्य रहेको छ। सहभागी हुन इच्छुक महानुभावहरूले यस [लिङ्कबाट](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018/registe)दर्ता गर्नु होस् । Please make sure to check the [Travel](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018#7837-travel) and [Accomodation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018#7836-accommodation) tabs.
